compile.description: Type-check and compile the extension to ./out

deps.description: Install the extension's dependencies exactly as pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml

commands: echo 'Installed {{ VAR.extensionId }} — run "Developer: Reload Window" in VS Code to activate.'
install.description: Package and (re)install the extension into VS Code, replacing any existing copy

package.description: Compile and package the extension into a .vsix (--out=<path> to override the file name)

uninstall.description: Remove the extension from VS Code
